name: sway-trace-mode-tage-update-diag
title: Diagnose why TAGE update path is silent in trace mode
creator: glr
notes: Symptom: in trace mode, system.cpu.branchPred.tage.updateMispred == 0 across all 7 championship traces collected on 2026-06-16, while system.cpu.branchPred.tage.predHit is non-zero (>260K on ipc1_client_001). MBTB+BTBTAGE-active-ways probe also reads 0 for all TAGE tables under trace mode. cpt mode (SPEC17) shows the expected non-zero update path. This blocks using championship traces as Q2 (stranded->IPC) evidence; for the CAL paper SPEC17 cpt data is sufficient, so this is P2. Becomes P1 when starting HPCA extension since DaCapo javac + extended workloads will also need trace mode.
